title: st.altair_chart unable to display alt.Chart that is deserialized from json
body:
### Checklist

- [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [X] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [X] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

st.altair_chart unable to display alt.Chart that was deserialized from json format. It shows a blank chart with labels but without data.

![visualization](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16421143/223775716-b63f192f-bc01-41a0-b1b3-1bf2b677c83d.png)
(see code that produced this in the example below)

- [ ]

### Reproducible Code Example

[![Open in Streamlit Cloud](https://static.streamlit.io/badges/streamlit_badge_black_white.svg)](https://issues.streamlitapp.com/?issue=gh-6269)

```Python
import streamlit as st
import altair as alt

chart = alt.Chart(pd.DataFrame(dict(x=list(range(10)),y=list(range(10))))).mark_line().encode(
    x=alt.X('x'),
    y=alt.Y('y'),
)
st.altair_chart(alt.Chart.from_json(chart.to_json()))
```


### Steps To Reproduce

_No response_

### Expected Behavior

Display the original chart. And should work for layered charts as well.

### Current Behavior

Shows blank chart, with labels but without data.

### Is this a regression?

- [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.19.0
- Python version: 3.7
- Operating System: MacOS 11.7
- Browser: Chrome

### Additional Information

_No response_

### Are you willing to submit a PR?

- [ ] Yes, I am willing to submit a PR!

comments.body:
[USER] I was able to reproduce the issue [here](https://issues.streamlitapp.com/?issue=gh-6269). There seems to be some issue with how we extract/process the data in our `altair_chart` command. Everything works fine if you load this JSON spec with `vega_lite_chart` (can be used as a workaround):

```python 
import json
st.vega_lite_chart(json.loads(chart.to_json()))
```

Your feedback helps us prioritize which bugs to investigate and address first.

I am making use of [USER] workaround because this issue has not been resolved.
